class.name: OcgGpLin2d
class.brief_description: Describes a line in 2D space. A line is positioned in the plane with an axis (a gp_Ax2d object) which gives the line its origin and unit vector. A line and an axis are similar objects, thus, we can convert one into the other. A line provides direct access to the majority of the edit and query functions available on its positioning axis. In addition, however, a line has specific functions for computing distances and positions. See Also GccAna and Geom2dGcc packages which provide functions for constructing lines defined by geometric constraints gce_MakeLin2d which provides functions for more complex line constructions Geom2d_Line which provides additional functions for constructing lines and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of lines

A ! line and an axis are similar objects, thus, we can convert ! one into the other. ! A line provides direct access to the majority of the edit ! and query functions available on its positioning axis. In ! addition, however, a line has specific functions for ! computing distances and positions. ! See Also ! GccAna and Geom2dGcc packages which provide ! functions for constructing lines defined by geometric ! constraints ! gce_MakeLin2d which provides functions for more ! complex line constructions ! Geom2d_Line which provides additional functions for ! constructing lines and works, in particular, with the ! parametric equations of lines

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a Line corresponding to X axis of the reference coordinate system.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a line located with theA.

method.name: from_3
method.description: <theP> is the location point (origin) of the line and <theV> is the direction of the line.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates the line from the equation theA*X + theB*Y + theC = 0.0 Raises ConstructionError if Sqrt(theA*theA + theB*theB) <= Resolution from gp. Raised if Sqrt(theA*theA + theB*theB) <= Resolution from gp.

method.name: Reversed
method.description: Reverses the positioning axis of this line. Note: - Reverse assigns the result to this line, while - Reversed creates a new one.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: Changes the direction of the line.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Changes the origin of the line.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Complete redefinition of the line. The "Location" point of <theA> is the origin of the line. The "Direction" of <theA> is the direction of the line.

method.name: Coefficients
method.description: Returns the normalized coefficients of the line : theA * X + theB * Y + theC = 0.

method.name: Direction
method.description: Returns the direction of the line.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the location point (origin) of the line.

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the axis placement one axis with the same location and direction as <me>.

method.name: Angle
method.description: Computes the angle between two lines in radians.

method.name: Distance_1
method.description: Computes the distance between <me> and the point <theP>.

method.name: Distance_2
method.description: Computes the distance between two lines.

method.name: SquareDistance_1
method.description: Computes the square distance between <me> and the point <theP>.

method.name: SquareDistance_2
method.description: Computes the square distance between two lines.

method.name: Normal
method.description: Computes the line normal to the direction of <me>, passing through the point <theP>.

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a line with respect to the point <theP> which is the center of the symmetry

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of a line with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates a line. theP is the center of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales a line. theS is the scaling value. Only the origin of the line is modified.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms a line with the transformation theT from class Trsf2d.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates a line in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates a line from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
